caption.text:
My therapist said, “Go after what you want.” ❤️

So here I am... running straight toward my favorite person with a heart full of love and flowers in hand. 💐

Tag the person you’d run through a crowd to see. 🥹💕

Sometimes love is simple:
When you know, you know.

#LoveMessages #RelationshipGoals #ILoveYou #CoupleGoals #RomanticQuotes

communication_seed.first_comment: Hey ❤️Vava❤️...IYKYK. Wish I could give you bouquet of flowers but then, just to make you smile and laugh, don't you think holding the flowers and walking down the street in hot weather would make me look like a fool. The positive side to this is -- could be that girls walking in the street may admire me (just teasing you) 😉😀😀. I love you lots. Take care, en kannmani kutti-vava ❤️❤️
